name: Caterpillar - Sanford NC Plant
type: Manufacturing plant (BCP - skid-steer, multi-terrain, compact track loaders)

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (35.5443,-79.1713) is ROOFTOP and - despite the 6 km movedMeters figure - lands directly on the Caterpillar Sanford manufacturing campus in Central Carolina Enterprise Park. Confirmed: large multi-building manufacturing complex with a long row of dock doors, trailer parking, material laydown yards, employee parking and a slatted perimeter fence. Consistent with the BCP skid-steer / multi-terrain / compact track loader plant (5000 Womack Rd; ~25 years in Sanford, 600 jobs being added).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole campus enclosed by a slatted privacy/chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed in Street View on the SW road). Truck access via internal entrance roads off the enterprise-park roads; controlled gates set inside the property.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth resolvable from public roads - the gates sit inside the fenced campus. Classified remoteGs (controlled fenced campus, internal checkpoint, no road-visible booth); low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal entrance roads run a long distance from the public road to the dock/yard areas - ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved truck aprons along the west dock face with unused width - room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~32 dock doors counted along the long west face of the main building (regular dock rhythm with trailers backed in); band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer parking along the west dock apron plus a second trailer/material staging area on the NE - capacity ~55.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is split between the long west-face dock bank and a separate NE building/laydown area, suggesting separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs through/alongside the campus (visible on the west and at the conveyor-bridge crossing); likely a serving spur - rail-served at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 6+ large connected/adjacent manufacturing and logistics buildings; Caterpillar has grown to 5 buildings in Lee County.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - Central Carolina Enterprise Park sits among woods and farmland north of Sanford, well outside any dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~220 acres for the fenced campus including parking, dock yards and laydown - approximate.

citations.claim: Caterpillar-owned Sanford NC facility (purchased 1996), 2,000+ employees, builds compact track loaders; expansion underway.
Caterpillar opening a new pre-assembly plant for skid-steer loaders in Sanford NC, $15M, 40 new jobs.

verification.rationale: CAT-owned BCP plant building skid-steer/compact-track loaders, 2,000+ employees, actively expanding; not a dealer, no closure.
